title: Task params for oedis.handler.amq.receive
description: Configuration for receiving one or more AMQP 1.0 messages over TLS with mutual TLS client certificate authentication.

connection.description: AMQP connection settings shared by all receive requests.

uri.description: AMQP 1.0 over TLS broker URI, for example amqps://broker.example.com:443.

timeout_sec.description: Optional connection and blocking operation timeout in seconds.

fault_tolerant.description: Retry settings for opening the AMQP connection.

retries.description: Number of retries after the initial connection attempt.

retry_interval_sec.description: Delay between connection retries in seconds.

auth.description: Mutual TLS client certificate authentication settings.

type.description: Use mutual TLS with a client certificate and private key.

certificate.description: Client certificate as PEM text or base64-encoded PEM text.

private_key.description: Client private key as PEM text or base64-encoded PEM text.

ca_certificate.description: Optional CA certificate as PEM text or base64-encoded PEM text.

requests.description: AMQP receive requests processed sequentially under one connection.

id.description: Optional request identifier used in logs and errors.

queue.description: AMQP source address or queue name.

max_messages.description: Maximum number of messages to receive for this request item.

wait_timeout_sec.description: Total wait budget in seconds for this request item.

file.description: Inbox-relative output file path template used for received message payloads.
